name: B10-0080/2025 (Renew) – Situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on 10 January 2025
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament says Edmundo González Urrutia is the rightful president of Venezuela, not Nicolás Maduro. It asks other countries to recognise González too. It calls for the release of everyone held arbitrarily, including European Union citizens, and for an end to repression. It welcomes new European Union sanctions on 15 people and asks for more. It is an opinion: the Parliament cannot change Venezuela's government itself.

- The Parliament recognises González as president and rejects Maduro; this is a political stance, not a legal change.
- It asks Venezuela to free detainees and stop repression; this affects prisoners, opponents and European Union citizens held there.
- It backs wider European Union sanctions and asks the International Criminal Court to investigate; next, other countries and European Union governments decide whether to act.
